list-environments.description: Get all environments in Confluent Cloud with pagination support

pageToken.description: Token for the next page of environments

read-environment.description: Get details of a specific environment by ID

environmentId.description: The ID of the environment to retrieve

list-clusters.description: Get all clusters in the Confluent Cloud environment

environmentId.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the cluster. Discover via list-environments

list-topics.description: List all topics in the Kafka cluster.

cluster_id.description: Confluent Cloud logical Kafka cluster ID (lkc-...). Discover via list-clusters.

environment_id.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the cluster. Discover via list-environments.

list-connectors.description: Retrieve a list of "names" of the active connectors. You can then make a read request for a specific connector by name.

environmentId.description: The unique identifier for the environment this resource belongs to.

clusterId.description: The unique identifier for the Kafka cluster.

list-compute-pools.description: Get the Flink compute pools in the Confluent Cloud environment. Paginated; if the response includes a nextPageToken, pass it back as pageToken to fetch additional pages.

environmentId.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the compute pools. Discover via list-environments

pageSize.description: Maximum compute pools to return in this response. Server-side default applies if omitted.

pageToken.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous response's _meta.nextPageToken. Omit on first request.

list-schemas.description: List all schemas in the Schema Registry.

latestOnly.description: If true, only return the latest version of each schema.

subjectPrefix.description: The prefix of the subject to list schemas for.

deleted.description: List deleted schemas. (Only used if latestOnly is false)

environment_id.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the Schema Registry. Discover via list-environments.

list-billing-costs.description: Retrieve billing cost data for a Confluent Cloud organization within a specified date range with pagination support

startDate.description: Start date for billing costs in YYYY-MM-DD format

endDate.description: End date for billing costs in YYYY-MM-DD format

pageToken.description: Token for the next page of results

list-available-metrics.description: List available Confluent Cloud metrics and their filter fields from the Telemetry API. Use this tool BEFORE query-metrics to discover valid metric names, resource filter fields, and grouping labels. This avoids guessing metric names.

resource_type.description: Filter metrics by resource type. Use "kafka" for Kafka cluster/topic metrics, "connector" for Kafka Connect metrics, "compute_pool" for Flink compute pool metrics, "flink_statement" for Flink statement metrics.

query-metrics.description: Query Confluent Cloud metrics from the Telemetry API. IMPORTANT: Use the list-available-metrics tool first to discover valid metric names and filter fields — do not guess them. Supports Kafka, Flink, Connectors, and Schema Registry metrics with flexible filtering, aggregation, and grouping.

metric.description: The metric name to query. Common Kafka metrics: "io.confluent.kafka.server/received_bytes", "io.confluent.kafka.server/sent_bytes", "io.confluent.kafka.server/received_records", "io.confluent.kafka.server/sent_records", "io.confluent.kafka.server/retained_bytes", "io.confluent.kafka.server/consumer_lag_offsets", "io.confluent.kafka.server/request_count". Common Flink metrics: "io.confluent.flink/num_records_in", "io.confluent.flink/num_records_out". Common Connector metrics: "io.confluent.kafka.connect/sent_records", "io.confluent.kafka.connect/received_records".

aggregation.description: Aggregation function to apply to the metric values.

filter.description: Key-value pairs to filter results. Use "resource.kafka.id" for cluster ID (e.g. "lkc-abc123"), "metric.topic" for topic name (e.g. "sensor-readings"), "metric.consumer_group_id" for consumer group, "resource.connector.id" for connector ID, "resource.environment.id" for environment ID, "resource.schema_registry.id" for schema registry ID. For Kafka topic metrics, "resource.kafka.id" is required.

granularity.description: Time granularity for the metric data points. Defaults to PT1M. Use PT1M or PT5M for intervals under a few hours, PT1H for day-scale queries, P1D for multi-day queries.

interval.description: Time range as two ISO 8601 timestamps separated by "/". Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z/2024-01-02T00:00:00Z". Must include both start and end timestamps. Defaults to the last 1 hour if omitted. Do NOT pass a duration like "PT1H" — always use "start/end" format.

group_by.description: Label keys to group results by. Common keys: "resource.kafka.id" (by cluster), "metric.topic" (by topic), "metric.partition" (by partition), "metric.consumer_group_id" (by consumer group), "metric.type" (by request type). Returns separate time series for each group.

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (max 1000).

list-tags.description: Retrieve all tags with definitions from Confluent Cloud Schema Registry.

environment_id.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the Schema Registry. Discover via list-environments.

search-topics-by-tag.description: List all topics in the Kafka cluster with the specified tag.

topicTag.description: The tag we wish to search for

limit.description: The maximum number of topics to return.

offset.description: The offset to start the search from. Used for pagination.

environment_id.description: Confluent Cloud environment ID (env-...) that owns the Schema Registry. Discover via list-environments.

get-connector-config.description: Retrieve the full configuration map for a connector. Returns the flat config object the connector was created/updated with.

environmentId.description: The unique identifier for the environment this resource belongs to.

clusterId.description: The unique identifier for the Kafka cluster.

connectorName.description: The unique name of the connector.
